summary: Project Instance notices another user's dataset changes on its own and offers a Refresh Table button, in every host rather than only in the desktop app.
details: The dataset table checks the selected reserving class's index every few seconds and compares it with the copy it loaded, instead of relying on a desktop-only folder watcher.
The prompt that appears is now labelled Refresh Table, so it reads as the action it performs rather than as a status.
Changes you make in your own window are adopted silently, and the check pauses while the window is hidden and catches up as soon as you return to it.
